# Copilot instructions

When you review changes in this repository, apply the `code-review` skill,
`.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`. It is this repo's one review rubric: what to check,
how to rate severity, and the `## Blocking` / `## Warnings` / `## Passed` output format.

For anything else, [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) is the contributor guide and the one place each rule
is written: repository layout, validating, releasing and conventions.
